title: Node Drain / Resume Wrapper (Slurm or PBS/PBS Pro)
description: Drains or resumes one or more compute nodes with a required reason, using scontrol (Slurm) or pbsnodes (PBS/PBS Pro), with a typed confirmation before anything destructive happens.

variables.name: REASON
variables.prompt: Reason to record (used for drain; ignored for resume)

toggles.name: REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION
toggles.prompt: Require typed YES confirmation before acting

toggle_groups.name: SCHEDULER
toggle_groups.prompt: Scheduler in use on this cluster
